ShortDescription.Value: Select an area and turn it into roads, parking, parks, shops, nature, farms or sports: 25 types, over 100 styles, every setting adjustable. Preview it, then build it.

Publish.LongDescription:
Placemaker fills an area for you. Select some land, choose what you want there, check the preview and build it.
[Watch the showcase video on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ghIR5UhFwj4) (3 minutes).
**Not just presets.** There are 25 types and over 100 styles to start from, and each one has its own settings: layout, paths, planting, surfaces, extras. Change anything and save it as your own style. That makes billions of combinations; the pictures show only a few.
It only uses the game's own assets, so no asset packs are needed.
**How to use**
1. Click the Placemaker button at the top left, or press Ctrl+Shift+A. 2. Select an area: click a city block, click corners, brush it on, or click the road nodes around it. 3. Choose a type and a style. The preview updates as you go. 4. Press Build. Undo works if you don't like it.
**What's in it**
- Roads: street grids connected to the roads around them - Parking: lots of any shape, with trees, lamps and fences - Parks: parks, gardens, memorial parks, playgrounds, amphitheatres - Beach: sand painted from the water's edge, quays and boardwalks - Shops & squares: strip malls, mall parks, mall districts, market squares - Nature: wetlands, reserves, lookout hills, hiking trails, campgrounds - Farms and Sports: farmsteads, animal parks, sports parks, golf, a skate spot
Most types have a few styles. Settings are under Options > Placemaker.
**Early version**
Roads, parking and parks are the most finished. Shops and squares still need work. Known issues:
- The strict grid and superblock road presets build nothing yet - Big builds can freeze the game for a second or two - Shops in plazas and market squares face the city street
If something looks wrong, please report it with a screenshot and your Placemaker.log (in the game's Logs folder).
**Credits**
Based on similar concepts to ParkingLotTool (KruemelGames), ParkManager (tomkpunkt) and Grid Road Generator. Includes Harmony by Andreas Pardeike (MIT). Licensed GPL-3.0, source code: [GitHub](https://github.com/jackwrichards/placemaker).

ChangeLog.Value: Area tools: the paint bucket follows roads and buildings more exactly and previews as you hover, painting shows a live outline, slow drags now paint, and fills pick up new buildings and zoning.
